ground_truth.title: Biggest Tech events 2026
ground_truth.main_content:
OCTOBER 13, 2025

As we move into 2026, technology continues to redefine industries, economies, and the way we live and work. From artificial intelligence and cloud computing to robotics, cybersecurity, and green tech, innovation is accelerating faster than ever. This year's leading tech conferences promise to bring together the world's brightest minds — from visionary entrepreneurs to top engineers and researchers — to share insights, explore emerging trends, and spark the next generation of breakthroughs. 

Whether you're looking to network with global tech leaders, discover transformative products, or gain inspiration for your next big idea, 2026's tech events have something for everyone. Join us as we highlight the most influential technology conferences of 2026, where innovation truly takes center stage.

1. CES (Consumer Electronics Show)
Date: January 6-9, 2026
Location: Las Vegas, USA
Focus: Consumer electronics, AI, IoT, smart devices, autonomous mobility.
Pricing: $150–$1,700 depending on tier and timing.

CES kicks off every tech year with futuristic product launches, from wearables and XR to EVs and smart homes. It's the ultimate showcase of “what's next” in consumer technology. A must for product developers, investors, and early adopters.

Registration:  https://www.ces.tech/
Photo David von Diemar on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/lila-und-blaue-lichter-auf-der-buhne-uHzf13WevGc

2. Mobile World Congress (MWC)
Date: March 2-5, 2026 (tentative)
Location: Barcelona, Spain
Focus: Mobile tech, telecom, 5G/6G, IoT, edge computing.
Pricing: €699 (basic) up to €2,000+ for premium passes.

The world's largest mobile industry gathering, where telcos, handset makers, and innovators unveil the next big shifts in connectivity. Expect demos, major announcements, and countless networking opportunities.

Registration:  https://www.mwcbarcelona.com/
Photo Anastasiya Badun on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/ein-museumsdisplay-mit-einem-grossen-blauen-ball-x_X6-3mNb58

3. Nvidia GTC
Date: 16-19 March 2026 
Location: San Jose, California, USA
Focus: GPU computing, AI, deep learning, and graphics technology.
Pricing (estimated): $0 (free) up to US $1,495 for paid passes

NVIDIA GTC (GPU Technology Conference) brings together developers, researchers, and technology leaders to explore advances in AI, accelerated computing, machine learning, and autonomous systems

Registration: https://www.nvidia.com/gtc/  
Photo Igor Omilaev on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/zwei-hande-die-sich-vor-blauem-hintergrund-beruhren-FHgWFzDDAOs

4. RSA Conference
Date: March 23-26, 2026
Location: San Francisco, USA
Focus: Cybersecurity, cryptography, threat intelligence.
Pricing: Typically $1,000+ depending on pass.

The cybersecurity world's most important event, bringing together researchers, CISOs, and vendors. Sessions cover threats, defenses, regulation, and emerging technologies in digital security.

Registration:  https://www.rsaconference.com/
Photo Jason Leung on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/ein-sehr-hohes-gebaude-mit-vielen-lichtern-a1tINXgeks4

5. Web Summit Rio 2026
Date: June 8-11, 2026
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Focus: Startups, investors, global innovation trends.
Pricing: Varies by tier (TBA).

The Latin American edition of Web Summit brings founders, investors, and global leaders together to explore regional opportunities. It blends startup pitches with global debates on AI, Web3, and sustainability.

Registration: https://rio.websummit.com/
Photo Dan Taylor on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/ein-gebaude-auf-dem-ein-schild-mit-der-aufschrift-web-summit-angebracht-ist-ciMLDc5PdRI

6. Google Cloud Next 2026
Date: April 22-24, 2026
Location: Las Vegas, USA
Focus: Cloud, AI, developer tools, enterprise services.
Pricing: Past editions included free virtual passes and paid in-person passes.

The must-attend for anyone in the Google Cloud ecosystem. Expect big announcements on AI, cloud services, data analytics, and developer platforms.

Registration:  https://cloud.withgoogle.com/next
Photo BoliviaInteligente on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/das-google-logo-wird-vor-einem-schwarzen-hintergrund-angezeigt-V8F_kUzqk0w

7. Dell Technologies World 2026
Date: May 18-21, 2026
Location: Las Vegas, USA
Focus: IT, cloud, infrastructure, enterprise tech.
Pricing: Typically $1,000+.

Dell's flagship IT event with keynotes, hands-on labs, and deep dives into AI, hybrid cloud, data, and security. A hub for enterprise tech professionals.

Registration:  https://www.delltechnologiesworld.com/
Photo Tyler Delgado on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/menschen-die-sich-im-raum-versammeln-T9gMZcw_0kA

8. Viva tec
Date: Usually in May/June (2026 date TBA)
Location: Paris, France
Focus: Innovation, startups, corporate-technology collaboration, AI, digital transformation
Pricing: Several pass tiers (exhibitor, startup, general, VIP)

VivaTech is one of Europe's leading innovation expos — a gathering of startups, corporate labs, investors, and global tech media to explore emerging trends and foster partnerships.

Registration: https://vivatechnology.com/get-your-pass
Photo https://vivatechnology.com/media/photos ©Viva Technology 2025

9. AI Summit London
Date: June 11-12, 2026
Location: Tobacco Dock, London, UK 
Focus: Commercial AI, real-world AI applications, enterprise adoption, AI at scale 
Pricing: Delegate ~ £2,399, VIP All Access ~ £2,749, and specialty passes (e.g. Tobacco Dock Campus) at ~ £200 

This flagship AI event brings together business leaders, engineers, and AI strategists to explore how AI moves beyond hype and into meaningful impact across industries. It features hands-on demos, expert panels, and immersive experiences to help attendees drive AI transformation.

Registration: https://london.theaisummit.com/register-interest
Photo Andrew Haha Lee on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/menschen-die-auf-braunen-holztreppen-gehen-euieMyZIBmY

10. Hinterland of Things
Date: 18 June 2026 (pre-registered) 
Location: Bielefeld, Germany (Ringlokschuppen)
Focus: Bridging industry leaders and emerging companies, digital transformation, partnerships, innovation in tech trends 
Pricing: Tickets likely vary (corporate, startup, student) – official pricing not fully published yet 

Hinterland of Things is a conference that fosters collaboration between established industry players and startups, highlighting emerging technologies, trend insight, and meaningful networking within a regional tech ecosystem.

Registration: https://hinterlandofthings.com/pre-register-2026/ 
Photo https://company-134903.frontify.com/d/vPzCRkM3Amxi/hinterland-of-things#/-/logo © 2024 Hinterland of Things

11. Apple Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC)
Date: June 2026 (Exact dates TBD)
Location: Cupertino, California, USA + Virtual / online
Focus: Apple software platforms (iOS, macOS, iPadOS, watchOS, visionOS, etc.), developer tools, APIs, previewing OS releases, and sometimes hardware announcements
Pricing: Historically, tickets (when in-person) were ~$1,599 via a lottery; many sessions are also available online to developers.

WWDC is Apple's annual developer gathering where they reveal updates to their software platforms, APIs, and occasionally new hardware, while enabling developers to engage in labs, sessions, and networking with Apple engineers. 

Registration: https://developer.apple.com/wwdc/ 
Photo Aaron Boucicault on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/weisse-pendelleuchten-nachts-eingeschaltet-jo8FE0gSSr8

12. Black Hat USA
Date: Usually August (exact 2026 date TBA)
Location: Las Vegas, NV, USA (often at Mandalay Bay)
Focus: Information security, offensive & defensive hacking, cybersecurity research, threat intelligence
Pricing: Standard passes often in the range of thousands USD (depending on tracks and workshops)

Black Hat is one of the preeminent security conferences—where security researchers, practitioners, and vendors present new vulnerabilities, tools, mitigation techniques, and deep technical content in offensive and defensive security domains.

Registration: TBD  https://www.blackhat.com/upcoming.html
Photo by Pixabay https://www.pexels.com/photo/assorted-color-laser-lights-417458

13. DEF CON
Date: Usually the weekend after Black Hat (August, exact 2026 TBA)
Location: Las Vegas, NV, USA
Focus: Hacking culture, security contests, talks, workshops, community hacking, social engineering
Pricing: Admission is modest (historically ~$300–$400 USD or less for attendance)

DEF CON is a legendary hacker conference — a mix of intense technical talks, capture-the-flag contests, hardware hacking, lockpicking, and community culture. Open, exploratory, and often irreverent.

Registration: https://defcon.org   (DEF CON homepage / FAQ — check for the exact pre-reg window each year)
Photo Max Bender on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/person-die-in-der-nahe-eines-led-schildes-steht-XIVDN9cxOVc

14. Bits & Pretzels
Date: Usually late September (2026 date TBA)
Location: Munich, Germany
Focus: Startup stories, networking, growth, entrepreneurship, tech & culture
Pricing: Multiple ticket types (founder, main conference, community passes)

Bits & Pretzels is a founders’ festival blending keynotes, panel discussions, and side events — a conference with a strong social and networking dimension in Europe's startup scenes.

Registration: https://checkout.bitsandpretzels.com/ 
Photo Luis Quintero https://www.pexels.com/photo/people-sitting-on-gang-chairs-2774556

15. SREcon26 Europe/Middle East/Africa
Date: 13-15 October 2026 
Location: The Convention Centre, Dublin, Ireland 
Focus: site reliability, systems engineering, and working with complex distributed systems at scale.
Pricing: $9500–$1,300 (estimate from previous years)

It brings together engineers passionate about site reliability, systems engineering, and managing complex distributed systems at scale. The event fosters critical thinking, deep technical insights, and innovation, offering value to both newcomers and seasoned professionals.

Registration: TBD https://www.usenix.org/conferences
Photo Ricardo L on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/blaue-und-weisse-bodenfliesen-2bCEHNTW324

16. Web Summit
Date: November (2026 dates TBA)
Location: Lisbon, Portugal (or location announced)
Focus: Startups, technology trends (AI, Web3, sustainability, digital marketing, enterprise tech)
Pricing: Multiple tiers (early bird, standard, VIP), often several hundred to over a thousand EUR / USD depending on access

Web Summit is one of the largest tech gatherings globally, combining startup exhibitions, big tech keynotes, track sessions, investor matchmaking, and coverage of broad tech themes.

Registration: https://websummit.com/tickets/attendees  
Photo Dan Taylor on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/eine-grosse-menschenmenge-in-einem-grossen-gebaude-PEYWee15Xjs

17. AWS re
Date: AWS re:Invent (typically Nov/Dec)
Location: re:Invent in Las Vegas, hybrid or virtual 
Focus: Cloud infrastructure, serverless, AI/ML in the AWS ecosystem, architecture best practices, security, operations
Pricing: Summit events are often free for attendees; re:Invent is fully paid ($1,799–$2,099 (previous years)

AWS events (especially re:Invent) are key for developers, cloud architects, and enterprises using AWS. You'll get deep dives into new services, use cases, hands-on labs, and networking across the cloud ecosystem.

Registration: https://reinvent.awsevents.com
Photo by Caleb Oquendo https://www.pexels.com/photo/audience-sitting-in-chairs-11329860

18. SLUSH
Date: Late November / early December (2026 date TBA)
Location: Helsinki, Finland (main)Focus: Startups, venture capital, deep tech, sustainability, founder growth, innovation
Pricing: Tiered tickets (startup, investor, general) — varying costs depending on timing and access

Slush is one of Europe's flagship startup + tech events, focused heavily on connecting founders and investors with a youthful and energetic platform. It features pitch stages, side events, matchmaking, and community energy.

Registration: https://slush.org (use the “Buy tickets” link)
Photo Declan Sun on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/das-personal-wacht-uber-eine-veranstaltung-mit-grossem-publikum-I7TQGsfbZhE

19. GITEX Global
Date: Summit on 7 December 2026, Expo from 8-11 December 2026
Location: Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City, Dubai, UAE
Focus: Tech, AI, startups, cross-sector innovation, future industries (quantum, biotech, data centers, Web3)
Pricing: (Not yet fully published) — as a major expo, likely multiple pass types (visitor, exhibitor, summit pass)

GITEX Global is the Middle East's flagship tech & startup show, featuring large expos, summit programming, heavy investor presence, and showcases across AI, enterprise tech, digital economy, and cutting-edge sectors.

Registration: https://visit.gitex.com/web/registration-portal/event-detail?eventId=252175
Photo Zack Xavier on https://unsplash.com/de/fotos/schwarzes-mikrofon-auf-stativ-VjzXKgCUqLw
